input_registration.method: phase correlation on an input-only 512x512 centre crop; full luma translated with fixed bilinear interpolation before site selection and temporal sigma

m1.formal_status: Sites frozen, but bee eligibility/noise floor is blocked by absent matching dark/FPN calibration and the scorecard does not define a bee defocused source.

m2.selection_rule: lowest quartile of opposite-light input-only structure; any site clipped in the scored light is excluded
m2.sigma_one: median robust bandpassed sigma across 16 disjoint consecutive frame pairs, divided by sqrt(2)

output_independence: All coordinates and sigma estimates came only from common inputs.
